title: borrowck is superlinear in the number of `.await`s in one function
author: ashi009
body_preview: An `async fn` with many awaits spends superlinear time in `mir_borrowck` — doubling the awaits costs ~9x. It is the `EverInitializedPlaces` fixpoint: it visits each basic block about N/2 times where N is the await count, while every other dataflow analysis over the same body settles in one or two. In our tree one 3539-line e2e test function with 679 awaits cost 8.4s of `mir_borrowck` on its own....

title: borrowck is superlinear in the number of values held across an `.await`
author: ashi009
body_preview: An `async fn` that holds K values across a single `.await` spends superlinear time in `mir_borrowck` — doubling K costs ~6.6x. It is one `dropck_outlives` call on the coroutine's own type, reached from `liveness::trace`'s dropck of boring locals.
